name: Mach Conferences & Events Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Mach Conference and Events Ltd offers solutions for organizing corporate conferences, training programs, and incentive events[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MCEL is an IATA, PATA, IATO, ADTOI certified 
 and in the business of arranging, coordinating, and carrying out formal Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Events (MICE) across the globe. It has conducted over 300+ large and medium-sized events involving 30+ elite brands.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 35.7%
cons: Debtor days have increased from 40.2 to 66.5 days.
Working capital days have increased from 30.5 days to 62.4 days
